visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt and blue jeans, stands in a brightly lit studio with bookshelves in the background. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures and facial movements. (2) A graphic overlay appears showing four surveillance cameras mounted on a pole against a blue sky, followed by a cut back to the man. (3) A scene in a dark room shows a silhouette of a person monitoring several security camera feeds on a large screen. (4) Graphic of a computer keyboard with the 'AI' key highlighted in blue light. (5) A visualization of a human brain with glowing neural networks. (6) A blue square graphic with white human silhouettes; one is highlighted with a green box and a question mark. (7) Screen capture of a water management dashboard with maps of Taiwan, river level graphs, and camera feeds. (8) A flowchart illustrating technical processes and a long text list of data sources. (9) A map of Taiwan with blue sensor dots and a red blinking alarm graphic. (10) Footage of a delivery driver on a scooter in a city street and a cartoon sheep character giving thumbs up. (11) Split-screen displays showing original flooded street footage compared with AI-detected areas highlighted in green, red, and pink masks. (12) Technical diagrams of neural network architectures (DCNN, Encoder/Decoder) and performance tables. (13) A mobile phone screen showing a LINE message from 'LINE_BOT' regarding flood alerts and an image of a field worker in an orange vest. (14) Footage of large water pumps and emergency personnel in uniform performing a flood drill. (15) The man in the studio concludes with an excited and confident expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 原來我們一直誤會的水利科學No.4. (2) [Subtitle]: 要掌握水情. (3) [Subtitle]: 不是攝影機或感測器裝得多就萬無一失. (4) [Subtitle]: 而是在幾秒內看遍全台灣的水情監視器. (5) [Subtitle]: 超過9,000支?! (6) [Subtitle]: 很遺憾, 沒有任何人類辦得到. (7) [Subtitle]: 而這就是AI在防災中真正的角色. (8) [Subtitle]: 它不是單純取代人類的眼睛. (9) [Subtitle]: 而是擔任消化海量資訊的超級大腦. (10) [Subtitle]: 從上千個畫面中瞬間找出那個最致命的魔鬼細節. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個AI超級大腦在經濟部水利署手上. (12) [Subtitle]: 已經被訓練成一個24小時不打烊的情報總監. (13) [Subtitle]: 它的工作就是即時整合來自四面八方的數據. (14) [Subtitle]: 包含全台超過9,000支的CCTV監視器. (15) [Subtitle]: 並搭配2,000支以上的淹水感測器. (16) [Subtitle]: 甚至還與物流業者合作. (17) [Subtitle]: 串接了超過800台的車載影像. (18) [Subtitle]: 讓送貨司機都成了移動的哨兵. (19) [Subtitle]: 補足了固定監測站的盲區. (20) [Subtitle]: 但光是看得廣, 資訊多還不夠. (21) [Slogan]: 準才是重點. (22) [Subtitle]: 過往AI經常會因為環境差異. (23) [Subtitle]: 讓AI無法正確辨識積水區域. (24) [Subtitle]: 例如原本是整片積水. (25) [Subtitle]: 卻因為晚上光線不夠亮. (26) [Subtitle]: 誤判成一個個破碎的小水灘. (27) [Subtitle]: 為了解決AI亂圈. (28) [Subtitle]: 水利署為AI導入了注意力機制. (29) [Subtitle]: 簡單來說, 在訓練視覺模型時. (30) [Subtitle]: 除了人工標記正確的積水範圍. (31) [Subtitle]: 也要標記出不可能出現積水的區域. (32) [Subtitle]: 一直提醒AI. (33) [Subtitle]: 積水是一整片的. (34) [Subtitle]: 積水不會在車頂上. (35) [Subtitle]: 讓AI別再隨便圈出破碎形狀. (36) [Subtitle]: 然而辨識再精準. (37) [Subtitle]: 下一步還是要能幫到現場. (38) [Subtitle]: AI找到問題後. (39) [Subtitle]: 會立刻透過LINE通知執行人員. (40) [Logo]: LINE_BOT. [Slogan]: 災情及時回報. (41) [Subtitle]: 讓執行人員儘早關注淹水感測器的數值. (42) [Subtitle]: 提前做出防災應變. (43) [Subtitle]: 提早通知民眾避開危險. (44) [Subtitle]: 而在颱風豪雨來襲時. (45) [Subtitle]: AI的預知能力就更關鍵了. (46) [Subtitle]: 它會整合歷史水文和氣象資料. (47) [Subtitle]: 透過深度學習去預測未來. (48) [Subtitle]: 1到4小時內. (49) [Subtitle]: 如八掌溪, 濁水溪, 曾文溪等主要河川的水位變化. (50) [Subtitle]: 但它的角色不是取代人類. (51) [Subtitle]: 而是為決策者排除雜訊. (58) [Subtitle]: 下次當你手機跳出即時的洪水警訊. (59) [Subtitle]: 或是在防災資訊服務網看到警示. (60) [Subtitle]: 那是背後有個AI. (61) [Subtitle]: 代替你盯著所有數據. (62) [Subtitle]: 從時間手中硬是搶回來的平安. (63) [Logo]: 經濟部水利署 廣告.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins speaking in a high-energy, authoritative tone. Mid-tempo electronic BGM with a consistent synth beat sets a tech-focused atmosphere. (2) A swift 'whoosh' SFX marks a visual transition to the camera graphic. (3) The narrator's speech is fast and clear, with frequent digital 'click' and 'ping' sound effects used to emphasize data points like '9,000 cameras.' (4) Transition SFX occur every few seconds as the visuals switch between the host and various graphics. (5) A subtle 'ding' sound effects is heard when key slogan text appears. (6) During clips of emergency personnel, a faint sound of cheering and ambient outdoor noise is layered briefly into the mix. (7) The BGM remains constant throughout, maintaining a major-mode, positive, and forward-moving vibe until the very end where it resolves with a final percussive hit.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Technical Explanation -> Implementation Examples -> Future Outlook -> Summary CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the public about the Water Resources Agency's advanced use of AI for flood prevention and water management. It explains the technical transition from simple sensor data to integrated AI analysis of thousands of camera feeds, highlighting the agency's proactive disaster response capabilities.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention and promotion of the Water Resources Agency's (Taiwan) AI system and disaster prevention services, with the agency's logo and 'Advertisement' tag at the end.
